securityCases.test: CLI local input rejects malformed roots and never follows symlinks outside the selected root.
CLI caps UTF-8 bytes per file and in aggregate, with below/at/above multibyte boundaries.
CLI traversal is capped by depth, file count, and directory entries with deterministic truncation metadata.
CLI keeps hostile filenames inert and removes terminal control sequences from human output.
GitHub adapter bounds streamed and parsed responses and maps malformed JSON, UTF-8, status, redirect, and timeout failures safely.
GitHub token is sent only in headers and never appears in normalized reports or errors.
SARIF paths and evidence are escaped and the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 schema validates generated documents.
